svg.title: Solstice Analytics: Labs 01 to 05 architecture
svg.desc: Lab 01 sets governance on every resource group. Lab 02 creates the RA-GZRS storage account and the prod VNet with a private endpoint. Lab 03 adds a zone-redundant scale set behind a Standard load balancer, a container batch job with a managed identity, and an App Service admin tool. Lab 04 adds a hub VNet with an ops VM, a dev spoke, NSGs and NAT gateways, with prod and dev not peered. Lab 05 sends storage logs and VM performance data to a Log Analytics workspace, alerts on CPU, storage availability and lock deletion, and backs up the ops VM.
svg.text: The finished platform: governance, private storage, a load-balanced API with a batch job, a hub-and-spoke network, and monitoring with backup.
East US and East US 2 only
hub ↔ prod and hub ↔ dev peered · prod ✕ dev
RA-GZRS · public access off after lock-down
Private DNS zone, linked to prod and hub VNets
app-solstice-admin · App Service B1 (the PaaS comparison)
(Lab 04 ops VM, backup not scale set)
Vault soft delete is not set in code
Five Terraform configurations, five state files. Each lab looks up earlier labs by name with data sources. Build order 01 → 05; destroy in reverse.
